title: Talk 1
original: Yea, when Yan scholars speak of Sui, that is us, and It too. Facts hardly worth covering up; Nian's worries are not mine. After all, I am only me, and my death, no more than death is. The only shames would be this wine and world, for at day's end I love them long.

title: Talk 1
original: Just who I wished to see; you fill the hole in this dream that stymied me. Yes, long will it be until we are met upon Rhodes Island, but this moment is no false one. Such is poetry's power, and wine's too. Pray, Doctor, serenade me, and be inebriated with me.

title: Talk 2
original: I was of the mind I would finally meet someone past, an old friend. Never did I think this is how you now present yourself. From knowing not one is one, isn't this like a dream? However, {@nickname}. It is fine to be as yourself. Long have I contended with myself; myself I shall prefer to act.

title: Talk 2
original: Seize it not! I don't mean to derelict my duty. Nay, you see, dreams are as this wine jar. Should I seek inebriation, its contents will never run dry—and this holds whether Sui wakes or not. In here, there is no hint of veracity or falsity, no fetter on one's ultimate freedom. Such is the highlight of dreams. Perhaps by this method, we can save 'us'.

title: Talk 3
original: Where the heart is as will, and its utterance is as verse. If wells your chest with depths manifold, wouldn't failing their writing be shame to meet yourself? Hm? My tail? Ah, so too do I make use of a common brush, naturally. But it is at times inconvenient, as an extremity would be. My body is an unfettered one; who says I can't use my tail?

title: Talk 3
original: Hurry now, lest we miss the morning roll call. Nay, nor could I stand all this regiment at first. But while our eldest brother exhorts I come to Yumen, still I stall. Stay a moment and you'll see why—for how heaven lights this sea of sand! We shall rue it if we miss it!

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Poetry, speech, lyric, essay. Though they all differ as their own, they are common in places. A pity the people of now are, by and large unable to exercise patience. To listen to a song, to read a poem. I take no objection to it, but how must our present scholars suffer.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Still Jie compiles her tome, and Yu is yet young… Our eldest brother frets so, and the basket of blunders has his own plots abrew, all in which I'm loath to interfere; thus am I trying my own ways. Oh! Say, what of the bickering couple? Come the dream, should we have Dusk painting in a hotpot restaurant's employ, and Nian serving as her underling? Good, nay?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: Nian is too impetuous, Dusk timid, yet to see the two as they are now, it seems they already know what they like, and want to do. So why probe at veracity or falsity or object or subject? To bicker and squabble every day, knowing emotion's gamut, is that not what a person is?

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: I seem an old friend, you say? Were you once an enemy or ally of Sui? If you are curious too of the answer, then assist me. When the time comes, I may return to the primordial chaos, for in the dream must exist at least one beyond Its effects. *yawn* I bid thee now unto my dream, to play the elements in song…

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: {@nickname}, would you want for me to compose you a verse? Hm? Nay, I'm simply in the mood. I need not write it, nor record it. Ah, wait, if it were a song... that would be quite good too! But to dance a song, I fear I would need some preparation. Good! You sit there, and await me a short while.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: It has snown in Yumen—the winds of spring a thousand li afar, pear trees through all the city blooming full. I could well sleep for six millennia here and now. Oh, this sight deserves a place in the dream—I'll write of it on these city walls with my tail, lest I forget. Hmm. And Doctor, take note of where this wall is for me.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: I am drunk? Hah... I have not yet seen the sky throw wide, moon rise, seas race, ice break, to wait true for all the world's sobriety would be but the withering of a bud, to want true for deep intoxication would be far too early still... {@nickname}, now, why do you say I am drunk?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: Have you decided, then? Within the dream, shall you be a speaking stone, or a water kettle of brew? With a dash of inebriation and a stroke of poetic spirit, one easily encompasses all the realm manifest. Ask yourself, Doctor, how could I ever mistake you?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Last night I dreamt of you. Nay! Perhaps it's you who dreamt of me. Oh, can you not recall? A shame; it delighted me so, yet I cannot share this revelry. Delighted how? Hmm. That eight thousand years of springs, eight thousand of winters, all dreamt, were no more than a brief handful of autumns. That is all.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Fail? And would the soldiers outside the tent flee in the face of a possible defeat? As humans have life and death, so the calendric Sui has spring and autumn. I take in sole the mantle of 'unfettered', and should I fail, then same as the sea washes and the ice melts, I shall never wake again, and that is that. Pray accompany me, Doctor, till this dream like no other is complete.

You may not be the old friend that lives in dreams, but that we lock eyes and converse apiece here is no misfortune to me at all.

title: Birthday

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: Yea, they are my writings over the walls. A fair accompaniment to your feastful merrymaking, I would tout. Why would I write, you ask? And what would be writ-worthy? Nay, it is but that the drinks flow free and spirits run high. To speak of which, your arrival is just so. I would still essay to hear from you—of much of Rhodes Island.

title: Anniversary Celebration
